title: Doc to STIX
description: Reads the document attached to an entity (PDF, HTML, text: a threat report, an advisory) with a language model, and enriches the entity with what the document states: intrusion sets, threat actors, malware, tools, MITRE ATT&CK techniques, CVEs, targeted sectors and countries, indicators and observables, and the relationships between them. On a container (report, grouping, case) the objects are added to it; on an intrusion set, malware or campaign the facts are attached to that entity. Runs on a local model (Ollama) or Claude.
short_description: Enrich an entity with the threat intelligence of its attached document.
